supabase.name: supabase
supabase.auth_instructions: OAuth login via browser or SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN. Run: claude mcp login supabase (or authenticate via mcp-remote browser prompt).

playwright.name: playwright
playwright.auth_instructions: Zero authentication required. Headless browser automation runs locally.

chrome-devtools.name: chrome-devtools
chrome-devtools.auth_instructions: Zero authentication required. Attaches to local Chrome debugging port.

github.name: github
github.auth_instructions: Requires GitHub Personal Access Token (repo, read:org scopes). Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in environment or .env.

vercel.name: vercel
vercel.auth_instructions: OAuth login via browser or Vercel API token. Run: claude mcp login vercel (or authenticate via mcp-remote browser prompt).

higgsfield.name: higgsfield
higgsfield.auth_instructions: Requires Higgsfield account credentials / OAuth. Run: claude mcp login higgsfield.
